label: Every file tracked at the baseline commit, classified by the rules in tools/repo_inventory.py, with dependencies measured from the baseline bytes and a final disposition recomputed from the current tree. Git history is not rewritten: a REMOVED file remains readable at the baseline commit.

classes.REMOVE: retired hardware theory, its outputs, documents, tests, tools, archives or a duplicate of a retained capability; leaves the tracked tree (Git history keeps it, unchanged)
classes.EXTRACT_GENERIC: generic capability living inside a retired package or file; moved to a generic home, its hardware coupling cut, then the source removed
classes.PRESERVE: current generic software, evidence or documentation; retained -- edited only to remove retired references or follow a rename
classes.REIMPLEMENT: a capability worth keeping whose implementation was bound to the retired programme; rebuilt over the generic layer with its own tests, the old file removed
classes.REGENERATE: a derived artefact (manifest, registry, status, lock); rebuilt by its generator from the new tree, never edited by hand
classes.REVIEW_DATA_PROVENANCE: learned-model evidence whose provenance had to be decided (generic or hardware-dependent) before it could be kept
